title: Reseller Programme Rates on Restore-Day Extensions of Domain Registrations
content:
**Reseller programme schedule — Domain Registrations restore-day extensions**

The restore-day reseller discount is the percentage discount that applies to a restore-day extension of Domain Registrations, that is extension years ordered on the day a redemption restore is charged on the domain. It follows the tier of the customer's account under Harborline Customer Accounts.

### Rule

The restore-day reseller discount is the domain renewal discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the customer's account tier: a Harborline Reseller Platinum account takes the Platinum percentage, a Harborline Reseller Gold account the Gold percentage, a Harborline Reseller Silver account the Silver percentage, a Harborline Reseller Bronze account the Bronze percentage, and every other account none.

### Schedule

| Account tier on Harborline Customer Accounts | Restore-day reseller discount |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Platinum tier |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Gold tier |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Silver tier |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | the domain renewal discount percentage of the Bronze tier |
| any other account | none |

### Points of judgement

- The tier is the one the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts record carries.
- Exactly one percentage applies: that of the account's own reseller tier, or none where the account holds no reseller tier.
